title: Active-Account Repayment Plan: Returned Deposits Paid Up Front (School Nutrition Services Meal Account)
content:
**Clause.** The repayment plan takes returned deposits up front, because a returned check is made good at once: when the active School Nutrition Services Meal Account shows returned deposits in the twelve months before the quote date amounting to at least its unpaid meal charges, all of the unpaid meal charges are paid up front and nothing is spread; when it shows returned deposits in that period amounting to less, those returned deposits are paid up front and only the rest is spread; otherwise nothing is paid up front and all of the charges are spread.

A date falls within the N months before the quote date when fewer than N whole calendar months separate it from the quote date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month or, when that later month has no such day, on the first day of the month after it.

## Input, judgement, result (hypothetical account owing 18.40)

| Returned deposits in the twelve months before the quote date | Paid up front | Spread over the installments |
|---|---|---|
| 25.00 | 18.40, all of it | nothing |
| 18.40 | 18.40, all of it | nothing |
| 6.00 | 6.00 | 12.40 |
| none | nothing | 18.40 |
